media.alt_text:
What to do to Prevent Wildfires 
Safety Tips
Campfire Safety:
Make sure campfires are permitted in the area
Properly extinguish your campfire
Home Safety:
Create a safety zone of up to 100 feet around structures
Clear dry weeds and vegetation
Remove debris from gutters
Trim branches 6 feet above the ground
Equipment Safety:
Never mow or trim dry vegetation on a red flag warning day
Spark arresters are required for all gasoline powered portable equipment used on public lands
Vehicle Safety
Don't drive onto dry grass or brush
Ensure trailer chains don't drag on the ground
Keep proper tire pressure to avoid driving on wheel rim
Don't let your brake pads wear thing
